import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for Age
data['Age'] = 2023 - data['Year_Birth']

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot for Income vs Age colored by Marital Status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Age', y='Income', hue='Marital_Status', alpha=0.6, palette='Set1')

# Add titles and labels
scatter_plot.set_title('Income vs Age by Marital Status', fontsize=16)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Income', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Marital Status', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
